archetypes.mobile_apps: Archetype 1: Organic & Earthy (Light) - adapted for Super App (High Contrast)
archetypes.dashboards: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast (Dark mode for Dispatcher, Light mode for Admin)

components.input: rounded-xl border-border bg-background px-4 py-3 text-base focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20
components.map_container: w-full h-full min-h-[400px] bg-muted/30 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden

animations.interactions: Use framer-motion. Floating bottom sheets should use spring physics (stiffness 300, damping 30). Hover states on bento grid cards should lift slightly (-translate-y-1) and increase shadow.
animations.page_transitions: Fade in with a slight vertical slide (y: 10 to 0) over 0.3s.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the User App using a mobile-first paradigm: max-w-md mx-auto on desktop, floating bottom sheets, and edge-to-edge maps.
Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone style for active, Regular for inactive) for the bottom navigation and bento grid icons.

For the Dispatcher Panel, enforce a strict Dark Mode. Use a 'Control Room' grid layout: the map takes up 70% of the screen (col-span-8 or 9), and active metrics/drivers take the sidebar (col-span-3 or 4).
For the Admin Panel, enforce a strict Light Mode Swiss Brutalist layout. Heavy use of 1px borders, white space, and dense data tables.
Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, map markers, service cards).
Use framer-motion for micro-interactions, especially the ride-booking flow transitions (sliding panels).
DO NOT use generic Inter for headings. Use Outfit for headings and Satoshi for body.
Make sure Map components (if mocked) have a fallback UI with a subtle pattern or use React Map GL.
